claims.assertion: Mari says Swaruu Oficial carries her direct updates; Robert and Gosia share complementary information from other crew members.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: Queen Alenym mentors Mari in Taygetan politics and exopolitics; Zaikira teaches engineering.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: Mari identifies Anna as Anéeka’s reincarnation but says Anna has a distinct personality.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: Her crew depends on Earth food and technology; its supply ship brings no human goods, and Taygetan plant foods poorly suit some.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: Mari says the Federation stopped funding Earth operations, so she must monetize her channel to support crew needs.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
